effects.name: Freezing Ice Guard
effects.tooltip: Freezing Ice Guard : This item stores the pitiless immovable power of the ice deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power occasionally comes to the surface, attempting to freeze an enemy solid and encase them in ice.

flavor_text: A sturdy suit of armor covered in a thin layer of ice and infuse with the power of cold. It seems to have been left on the ocean floor and taken on the properties of the freezing, forbidding depths.
